Method of Attack: Spear phishing emails containing confidential information
Exploitation of CVE-2017-11882 Microsoft Office vulnerability
Lateral movement through enterprise networks using network scanning, vulnerability search and exploitation, and password attacks (e.g., Ladon hacking utility)
Collection and theft of system information and files
Use of vulnerable Microsoft Word versions bundled with payload
Impacted Systems: Industrial plants, design bureaus, research institutes, government agencies, ministries and departments in Belarus, Russia, Ukraine, and Afghanistan
Attack Vector: Malicious code exploiting Microsoft Office vulnerability CVE-2017-11882
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted and password-protected ZIP archives sent to command-and-control (C2) servers
C2 servers forwarding stolen data to second-stage server with Chinese IP address
Malware and C2 servers previously linked to Chinese APT group TA428
Connections to infected systems during Chinese business hours
